subject: Transition: Vantum Health - Implementation Owner & Next Steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ari Sherman <ari.sherman@vantumhealth.com>, Rachel Lowe <rachel.lowe@vantumhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Transition: Vantum Health - Implementation Owner & Next Steps
Attachments: Vantum_Deal_Summary.pdf (pdf), Pricing_Term_Sheet.xlsx (sheet)

Hi team,

Quick summary to hand this over to CS: Vantum Health (payer-tech) signed a one-year reserved capacity commitment for Redwood Dedicated (estimated baseline 6K tokens/sec peak, with burst windows). Target go-live: mid-June (opt window 6/14–6/21). Key customer constraints: US-only data residency, Okta SSO (SAML 2.0), PII retention policy requires 30d logs retention and quarterly audit export. Procurement is finalizing a minor term in DocuSign; Benccs finance needs to confirm billing contact.

Open items we need CS to lead:
- Kickoff & runbook: schedule kickoff (goal: early May) and produce implementation runbook.
- SSO integration: validate Okta attributes and provide test IdP.
- Engineering touchpoints: Vantum has two backend engineers (Ari and Stephen, CCed); expect one integration sprint and one acceptance sprint.
- Acceptance criteria: performance targets (p90 latency <120ms for 512 tokens), and acceptance tests included in SOW.

Risk notes: small integration team, procurement still drafting a final clause about fallback capacity (we should offer a short-term burst plan).

Please let us know who will be the Implementation Lead and preferred kickoff dates; Marissa, would you be able to own this? Karthik, please prepare the SSO questionnaire and highlight any security items we should call out before kickoff.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0164

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Ari Sherman <ari.sherman@vantumhealth.com>, Rachel Lowe <rachel.lowe@vantumhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Transition: Vantum Health - Implementation Owner & Next Steps

Thanks Ben — appreciate the concise summary.

Marissa: can you take Implementation Lead for Vantum? They look like a straightforward Dedicated deployment but with the SSO and retention items that need close attention. Proposed kickoff week: May 3–7; my preference is Tue/Wed May 4 or 5 to give Karthik time for the SSO questionnaire and for legal to finish the small procurement note.

Internal context for CS:
- Model & infra: customer will run on our Dedicated tier, model family pinned to redwood/gpt-infer-8k-quant for cost/latency balance. Expect to enable prefix caching for system prompts and configure KV cache limits to reduce token spend.
- Billing/ops: this is a reserved capacity deal with a finance kickoff after DocuSign execution; we may need an interim burst policy if we hit early spikes.
- Security: we must supply SOC2 artifact package and the logs-export process; Karthik, I realize you own the evidence bundle — can you stage the SOC2 evidence and SSO questionnaire in the shared Drive link?

Marissa — if you accept, please:
1) Confirm owner and kickoff slot.
2) Create Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and share with customer by EOD tomorrow.
3) Outline a 6-week implementation timeline and initial acceptance test plan.

I'll remain in the thread for escalation.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Customer Success Operations | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0122

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ari Sherman <ari.sherman@vantumhealth.com>, Rachel Lowe <rachel.lowe@vantumhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Transition: Vantum Health - Implementation Owner & Next Steps
Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (sheet), SOW_Draft_v1.docx (docx)

Hi Ari and Rachel — pleased to meet you. Thanks Ben and Olga for the handoff.

I’m happy to own the implementation for Vantum Health and will act as the primary point of contact for the kickoff and delivery. Proposed kickoff meeting: Tuesday, May 4 at 10:00 AM PT (60 min). Agenda: introductions, success criteria, SSO requirements, engineering touchpoints, and acceptance timeline. Please let me know if that works or share availability.

Pre-kickoff asks (so the first meeting is productive):
- Please share the Okta test IdP metadata or a sandbox account (SAML metadata or test URL).
- Provide the technical contact for SSO (name/email) and the primary API/integration engineer.
- Confirm the initial dataset for acceptance testing (sample queries and expected result shape).

I’ve attached a working Mutual Action Plan and a draft SOW for your review. I’ll turn these into a shared Google Drive folder and send a calendar invite with a Zoom link once Ari/Rachel confirm kickoff timing.

SSO admin: Stephen Park (stephen.park@vantumhealth.com) — contact card attached. Our engineers (Ari and Stephen) will join the kickoff. Procurement is wrapping the final DocuSign edits this afternoon; envelope ID ABC-12345 should arrive to Ben’s inbox for signature. We can provide a sandbox Okta instance; Stephen will share metadata before the meeting.

One note on acceptance: we will provide the sample dataset and expected response shapes by next Friday to help you populate acceptance tests. Also confirm whether Redwood will need a dedicated staging endpoint (preferred) or if we should run tests against a shared staging host.
